calculation.description: For each asset, compute the cross-sectional median of the lagged five-trading-day returns of the other available tradable benchmark assets. The signal is point-in-time and excludes the target asset itself. Positive values indicate broad peer strength.

validation.regime_notes: One-day IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.056630; ICIR 0.193212), 2023-2024 (0.045601; 0.145640), 2025-2026-06 (0.020288; 0.068552), and the online-period slice 2026-07-01 to 2027-02-25 (0.022344; 0.080357). Three-day predictive power decays but remains positive; longer horizons are weak.
validation.provenance: Signal artifact generated from close data available through each date; cross-section used 15 assets with date-level minimum 8.
